title: 第12章 击杀王虎第13章 轩然大波
lines: 第12章击杀王虎
傍晚，天空突然下起了大雨。
楚生腰挎砍刀，在雨中行走，犹如一个侠客。
雨幕中，红色的面板在楚生眼中格外显眼。
【姓名：楚生】
【杀戮值：0】
【修为进度：淬皮境初阶100100】
【境界：未激活】
今天，楚生再次获得26点杀戮值。
结束工作后，楚生就将杀戮值清零。
任由雨水在身上流淌，楚生自信满满道：“10点的《追风步》用来杀鸡，已经轻而易举了，53点的气血值，让我忙碌一天依旧没有丝毫疲惫。”
“只要干两天，气血就可以满100了，应该就可以成为进阶淬皮境武者了吧？”
楚生没有办法，面板没有说明书，没有提示，只能根据自己的分析来加点。
走在稀稀落落的街道上，听到有人议论道：
“这城北的天，就要变了，黑虎帮数百人被击溃，湘水河都被血液染红，王虎重伤，不知所踪。”
“城西的青蛇帮得了大胜，明日估计就要来接手这里了吧？也不知道青蛇帮比黑虎帮如何！”
“都是敲人髓吸人血的货色，没一个好东西，你对他们抱有什么希望？”
“嘘，小点声，鬼知道有没有青蛇帮的人在附近？”
声音渐行渐远，楚生深吐了一口气，喃喃道：“黑虎帮被青蛇帮灭了？”
淅淅沥沥的雨水中，楚生轻松了不少。
楚生到家时，雨停了，夜色彻底黑了。
没等楚生坐下，院门就被一脚踹开，一道狰狞的声音传来：
“小畜生，终于回来了，我可等你好久啊！”
楚生站起身来，将母亲护到身后，叮嘱道：“母亲，你去房间里！”
“生儿，那你怎么办？”龙珍抱起板凳作出防御姿态，担忧道。
楚生佯装轻松，安慰道：“母亲，你儿子可是学了武的，相信我！”
龙珍纠结地进入房间，面露紧张之色。
母亲进入房间后，楚生这才走出房门，认真打量院中之人。
来人手握砍刀，披头散发，满脸横肉，唯有身上被砍破的华服表明此人之前高贵的身份。
“王虎？”楚生将脑海中印象重合，试探问道。
“不错，正是你虎爷！”水滴从刀剑滴落，寒光摄人，王虎向前靠近，嚣张道。
楚生神色一紧，恐吓道：“你不怕青蛇帮的人来？”
“小杂种，宰了你和你母亲，耽误不了我多少功夫。”王虎脸上横肉抖动，不屑道，“敢杀我弟弟，我将你扒皮抽筋。”
“不是我！”楚生手已经握住刀柄，冰冷回应。
“崽种，这不重要，我说是你，那就是你。”王虎挥舞着长刀，戏谑道，“既然等不到你哥哥妹妹，他们就留着下次玩吧！”
王虎一语说罢，便挥刀直冲而来。
楚生知道解释再多都没用，直接拔刀硬接，刀光在黑夜中直接闪现火花。
王虎不断挥刀，挥出一道道残影，每一刀都直击要害，刀锋凛冽。
楚生凭借超强灵魂感知力和远超常人的气血，每一次慌乱挥刀中都精准挡住王虎的斩击。
接连几招都失手，双手更是被挣得发麻，伤口再次撕裂，王虎震惊道：“怎么可能，你不是屠夫学徒吗？怎么这么强！”
content_en:
Chapter 12 Killing Wang Hu
In the evening, it suddenly started raining heavily.
Chu Sheng was walking in the rain with a machete on his waist, like a knight.
In the rain curtain, the red panel stood out in Chu Sheng's eyes.
[Name: Chu Sheng]
[Kill value: 0]
[Qi and blood: 53]
[Cultivation progress: Beginner level of skin tempering realm 100100]
[Exercise: "Five Elements Technique" 50100]
[Martial skill: "Chasing Wind Step" 10100]
[Realm: Inactive]
Today, Chu Sheng once again gained 26 kill points.
After finishing his work, Chu Sheng cleared the kill value to zero.
Letting the rain flow on his body, Chu Sheng said confidently: "The 10-point "Wind Chasing Step" can be used to kill chickens with ease. The 53-point blood value allows me to work hard for a day and still not feel tired at all."
"Just two days of work, the energy and blood will reach 100, and you should be able to become an advanced skin-tempering realm warrior, right?"
Chu Sheng had no choice. There was no manual or prompt on the panel, so he could only add points based on his own analysis.
Walking on the sparse streets, I heard someone talking:
"The sky in the north of the city is about to change. Hundreds of Black Tiger Gang members have been defeated. The Xiangshui River is dyed red with blood. Wang Hu is seriously injured and missing."
"The Green Snake Gang in the west of the city has won a big victory. I guess they will come to take over this place tomorrow, right? I don't know how the Green Snake Gang is compared to the Black Tiger Gang!"
"They are all just knocking people's marrow and sucking their blood. None of them are good. What hope do you have for them?"
"Shh, keep your voice down. Who knows if anyone from the Green Snake Gang is around?"
As the voice faded away, Chu Sheng took a deep breath and murmured: "The Black Tiger Gang was wiped out by the Green Snake Gang?"
In the pouring rain, Chu Sheng felt a lot more relaxed.
When Chu Sheng arrived home, the rain stopped and the night was completely dark.
"Bang!"
Before Chu Sheng could sit down, the courtyard door was kicked open, and a ferocious voice came:
"You little beast, you're finally back. I've been waiting for you for a long time!"
Chu Sheng stood up, protected his mother behind him, and warned: "Mom, go to the room!"
"Son, what will you do?" Long Zhen picked up the bench and made a defensive posture, worried.
Chu Sheng pretended to be relaxed and comforted: "Mother, your son has learned martial arts, believe me!"
Long Zhen entered the room with a nervous look on her face.
After his mother entered the room, Chu Sheng walked out of the room and carefully looked at the people in the courtyard.
The person who came was holding a machete in his hand, his hair was disheveled, and his face was full of flesh. Only the torn fine clothes on his body showed his previous noble status.
"Wang Hu?" Chu Sheng asked tentatively after overlapping the impressions in his mind.
"Yes, it's your Lord Hu!" Water drops dripped from the sword, and the cold light caught people's eyes. Wang Hu stepped forward and said arrogantly.
Chu Sheng's expression tightened and he threatened, "Aren't you afraid of people from the Green Snake Gang coming?"
"Little bastard, if I kill you and your mother, it won't take much time for me." Wang Hu's face trembled with disdain, "If you dare to kill my brother, I will skin you and cramp you."
"It's not me!" Chu Sheng's hand had already grasped the handle of the knife and he responded coldly.
"Zi Zhong, it's not important. If I say it's you, then it's you." Wang Hu waved his long knife and joked, "Since we can't wait for your brother and sister, let them keep it for next time!"
As soon as Wang Hu said this, he rushed towards him with his sword.
Chu Sheng knew that no amount of explanations would be of any use, so he directly drew his sword and faced it head-on. The sword's light flashed sparks in the dark night.
"Zheng——"
Wang Hu kept swinging the knife, creating afterimages one after another. Each knife hit the vital point directly, and the blade was sharp.
With his super soul perception and energy and blood far beyond ordinary people, Chu Sheng accurately blocked Wang Hu's slashes every time he swung his sword in a panic.
After several consecutive moves, he missed, his hands were numb, and the wound was torn again. Wang Hu was shocked and said: "How is it possible? You are not a butcher's apprentice? How can you be so strong!"
